name: The Shoulder pilgrimage
what_happens: walk the road up to the shoulder of the peak, keep vigil, come down
what_it_claims: THE ASCENT MUST BE PERMITTED, NEVER ATTEMPTED. Nobody summits. The peak is not a destination, and daring is the sin
notes: the one thing they believe is up there is the one place their own doctrine forbids them to reach; when somebody finally goes over the top it is a SCHISM, not an adventure

name: The oracle of the dead
what_happens: a real building at the mouth of the high valley, staffed, with a waiting list; you fast, you are led down, you are permitted one question
what_it_claims: the dead are not resting, they are busy, and they can be reached at a price
notes: COMMERCIALISED RELIGION, played straight: people come from both states, including people who despise the sect, because their child died in the plague and they want to ask something. This -- not doctrine -- is how the Continuing Word gets its reach

name: The high burial
what_happens: the dead are left on a charnel terrace at altitude for the birds
what_it_claims: the body is a vessel; the soul has a post to get to and should not be delayed
notes: grimly practical above the treeline where the ground is frozen; also an unforgettable map

name: Enrolment of the dead
what_happens: the plague dead are rebaptised by name, read off the parish lists
what_it_claims: nobody is enrolled without their name being spoken
notes: puts the prophets and the crown's clerks in the same archive, for opposite reasons
